title: Sample Plating Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Obtain the protocol file from the Opentrons website or provided link.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons OT‑2 Run App (Version 4.1.0 or later) and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place the required labware on the OT‑2 deck exactly as shown in the deck map:

substeps.instruction: Insert the Opentrons 4‑in‑1 Tube Rack Set (with the 3 × 5 15 mL tube insert) into the designated slot and load Avantik 3 mL Viral Transport Medium Tubes (#GL4692) into the rack.
Load the Opentrons 200 µL Filter or 300 µL Standard tip rack (compatible with the P300 GEN2 Single‑Channel Pipette) into its assigned slot.
Place the NEST 96 Deepwell Plate (2 mL wells) into the well‑plate slot indicated on the map.

steps.title: Load pipette and attach tips
steps.instruction: Mount the Opentrons P300 GEN2 Single‑Channel Pipette on the robot and attach the appropriate tip type.

substeps.instruction: If transferring ≤200 µL, use the 200 µL Filter tips.
If transferring up to 300 µL, use the 300 µL Standard tips.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 App, run the calibration routine for the pipette, tip rack, tube rack, and deepwell plate.

substeps.instruction: Select “Calibrate Labware” and follow the on‑screen prompts for each piece of equipment.
Refer to Opentrons support articles for details on using calibration tips.

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Start the automated sample plating by pressing the “Run” button in the OT‑2 App.

substeps.instruction: The robot will transfer the user‑specified volume from each tube (top‑to‑bottom, left‑to‑right order) to the corresponding well of the 96‑deepwell plate.
